    launch(Class, String[]) - Static method in class be.imgn.swing.ui.Swing
    Launches an application, in these steps: on the main thread, reads the descriptor of the application class; on macOS, sets apple.awt.application.name to its name and apple.laf.useScreenMenuBar to true; on the main thread, builds the root injector, which binds ApplicationInfo, Arguments, DisplayLocale and the application Scope; on the main thread, runs every StartupStep, sorted by order then by class name; on the EDT, installs the look and feel, checks the icons, then creates the main window of a SingleFrame application class and shows it, or calls the MultiFrame.start(Frames, Arguments) of a multi-frame one, which opens the first frames; on the EDT, once the events posted while showing the windows have run, calls the application class's SingleFrame.ready() or MultiFrame.ready(), then every ReadyListener.

    Handles a second launch, on the EDT, in the first instance, once the application is ready, in the order the launches arrived.
